description: Queue a persistent weapon-aware motion draft from an owned armed GLB. Axe/hammer get distinct procedural cleave, backhand and overhead attacks; sword uses the explicit UAL sword pack. Staff attacks fail with compatible_motion_missing; no silent sword fallback. Holds Grip finger poses, supports a second-hand anchor with IK. Poll gripforge_generation_read, cancel/retry with generation tools. Returns a NEW work asset and Character Studio URL; never replaces the game/source or visually validates a result. 0 generation credits.

family.description: Required on the first call. Never infer axe vs sword from geometry alone.

secondaryAnchor.description: Required for two hands; weapon-node local coordinates.
